title: 냉장고 마지막 밤
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a male baritone vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A legato string section provides harmonic support with slow-moving pads. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of C Major. The vocal performance is intimate, utilizing breathy delivery in the lower register and transitioning to a clear, resonant tone as the pitch rises. The production features a long plate reverb on the vocals and piano, creating a spacious acoustic environment.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[sustained grand piano chords, legato string pads]

[Verse 1]
[intimate male baritone vocals]
명절 전날 오후였지
한방 장롱을 닦다가
맨 위 칸에 손이 닿는데
낡은 봉투 하나 거기 있었어
아버지 글씨더라
잉크 색이 기억나서
